query:
WITH seats AS (
    SELECT rs.seat, rs.session_id AS sid, rs.launched_at
      FROM launch.run_seats rs
     WHERE rs.run_id = $1
)
SELECT (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(coalesce(t.user_prompt, '')), '{}')
          FROM memory.operator_turns t
          JOIN seats s ON s.sid = t.session_id AND t.created_at >= s.launched_at
         WHERE t.opened_by = 'operator') AS "operator_prompts!",
       (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT l.seat), '{}')
          FROM launch.launches l
         WHERE l.run_id = $1 AND l.seat IS NOT NULL) AS "seat_names!",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM workspace.session_notes n
          JOIN seats s ON s.sid = n.session_id
         WHERE n.kind = 'note' AND n.status IN ('operator', 'answered')) AS "operator_answers!",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM workspace.session_notes n
          JOIN seats s ON s.sid = n.session_id
         WHERE n.kind = 'report') AS "reports_filed!"
